title: Milo the Moonbeam Mouse
style: cute children's storybook illustration, soft watercolor, gentle pastel colors, magical night atmosphere, warm glowing light, adorable, high quality, friendly
character: Milo, a tiny soft grey mouse with big shiny black eyes, pink nose, and tiny rounded ears

scenes.text: High on a quiet rooftop lived a tiny grey mouse named Milo. Every night he watched the big, glowing moon and whispered, I wish I could touch you.
scenes.image: Tiny soft grey mouse Milo sitting on a quiet rooftop at night, looking up at a large glowing full moon with big hopeful eyes, soft starry sky, gentle pastel watercolor style

scenes.text: One special night a soft silver moonbeam reached down like a ladder. Milo’s whiskers twitched with courage. He climbed… and climbed… higher than any mouse had ever gone.
scenes.image: Tiny grey mouse Milo climbing a glowing silver moonbeam ladder into the night sky, looking determined and amazed, soft magical light, stars around him, watercolor children's book style

scenes.text: At the top of the moonbeam he met the Moon herself — round, gentle, and smiling. She gave him a tiny piece of her light to keep forever in his heart.
scenes.image: Tiny mouse Milo meeting a kind smiling full Moon face high in the sky, Moon giving him a small glowing piece of light, soft magical golden and silver light, warm and gentle atmosphere

scenes.text: Milo slid home on a ribbon of starlight. From that night on, whenever he felt small or scared, the warm moonbeam in his heart reminded him: even the tiniest mouse can reach the sky. The end.
scenes.image: Tiny mouse Milo sliding happily down a ribbon of glowing starlight back to his rooftop home, holding a small glowing light in his paws, soft night sky with stars and a gentle moon, warm peaceful ending
